promptLatex: What is the minimum number of integers that must be selected from {1, 2, ..., 30} to guarantee that at least one pair has a sum of 31?
hintLatex: Pair the numbers into 15 pairs that sum to 31: (1,30), (2,29), (3,28), ..., (15,16).
If we select 16 numbers (pigeons), by pigeonhole, at least one pair is fully selected, giving a sum of 31.
If we select 15 numbers, we could select exactly one from each pair, avoiding any sum of 31.
solutionLatex: Pair the numbers 1 through 30 into 15 pairs that each sum to 31: (1,30), (2,29), (3,28), ..., (15,16). These 15 pairs are the pigeonholes.
